title: MiMo Halo artifact manifest
description: Public contract for manifest.json sidecars created by mimo_halo.artifacts. Byte fields are integer bytes. The canonical manifest digest (manifest_sha256) is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form (sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII-safe UTF-8) of the manifest object with the manifest_sha256 field excluded; it provides integrity only and is not an authenticity or signature claim.

kind.description: Artifact stage. Stage requirements: calibration needs calibration_config and a seed; pruned needs an expert_map and a seed; recovered needs a pruned parent and a seed; quantized needs pruned + recovered + calibration-post-recovery parents and a quant_assignment; evaluation needs a candidate parent and a metrics sidecar. Unquantized stages never require quant fields.

created_at.description: Caller-supplied creation timestamp. Omitted (not zero) when not provided, so identical inputs stay byte-identical.

seed.description: Explicit deterministic seed for seeded stages; null when the stage has no seeded computation. Unknown is null, never zero.

parents.description: Lineage: digests of parent artifacts (their canonical manifest digests), keyed by role. No anonymous moving branches anywhere in lineage.

kind.description: Declared parent stage. When present it must match the role: dataset->dataset, pruned->pruned, recovered->recovered, calibration-post-recovery->calibration.

official_source.description: The declared official Xiaomi source. Declaration-based only: no signature verification is performed and none is claimed.

revision.description: Immutable full revision: a 40-hex git/HF commit SHA or a 64-hex content digest. Moving refs and abbreviated SHAs are rejected by create and verify.

inputs.description: Structured stage inputs referenced by role; each value is the file name inside the artifact root, digested via files.

files.description: Every payload file and every sidecar except manifest.json and checksums.txt, sorted by path. checksums.txt explains these files plus manifest.json itself.

relativePath.description: Relative POSIX path confined to the artifact root; no absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, or empty components. Symlinks are rejected outright.
